title: Two unrelated NPCs are both simply called 'Rook' — the woods poacher Captain Vane wants dealt with near Camp Gallows (Thornwold), and Sergeant Rook, the drill instructor at Highward (Wardmoor). Neither is given a distinguishing title in casual reference, risking confusion when tracking quest targets by name across regions.
where: Captain Vane's Tent (Thornwold) / The Parade Ground (Wardmoor)
